name: Riverside Country Club
description: A private country club in Provo with indoor dining and event rooms and a patio overlooking the golf course and Mount Timpanogos. Weddings include an in-house culinary team, white linen, serving staff and an on-site venue coordinator; food and beverage minimums apply.
priceText: Room fees $600–$3,500, plus food & beverage minimums $900–$8,000
